secondary_source.role: cross-check; later exact scalar values retained

accepted_facts: Brochure page 20 provides inclusive combined-cycle CO2 ranges for mild hybrid 140, mild hybrid-G 140 and hybrid 155.
Brochure page 20 provides inclusive combined-cycle fuel-consumption ranges for the same powertrains.
Hybrid-G 150 4x4 is excluded because the July price-list scalar values are already exact and the reviewed reconciliation identifies no approved range import for that powertrain.
preserved_conflicts: Hybrid 155 brochure states 280 V while later July price-list data records 200 V; no voltage overwrite.
Mild hybrid-G 140 payload brochure range conflicts with later exact price-list range; no payload change.
Hybrid-G 150 4x4 technical naming/equipment conflicts remain deferred.
not_imported: Eco mode, hybrid battery type and hybrid-system power total were already represented in master data.
Current configurator observations were not used for this documentary import.
